class.name: HTMLDocument
class.brief_description: A shareable source document for static HTML.
class.description: Load an imported [code].html[/code] or [code].htm[/code] file, or create an [HTMLDocument] and set its [member text]. Assign the resource to [member HTMLLabel.document] for automatic display. Use [method create_layout] when drawing directly. Scripts that previously called [code]HTMLDocument.new().parse(html)[/code] should call [code]HTMLLayout.new().parse(html)[/code]. Each [HTMLLayout] keeps its own parsed document, viewport, and drawing state. The HTML importer embeds linked and imported CSS and records their textures as resource dependencies for export. Reimport the HTML file after changing a linked stylesheet. Imported documents include local image dependencies from all media query branches. In a selected-scenes export preset, add [code]addons/docrender/docrender.gdextension[/code] to the include filter so the exported project can load DocRender classes.

method.name: create_layout
method.description: Parses a snapshot of this resource into a new [HTMLLayout]. Call [method HTMLLayout.layout] with the target viewport size, then [method HTMLLayout.draw] to display it. See [method HTMLLayout.get_render_error] for parse or layout errors.

members.member: The project directory used for relative image paths. Imported resources use the source file's directory.
Additional CSS for this document. Its rules follow the document's stylesheets in the author cascade. See [method HTMLLayout.parse].
The source HTML document or fragment.
